description: This file defines an Angular component for the 'play' page of a Tic-Tac-Toe game application. It manages game creation, joining, state updates, move handling, and polling for real-time updates, integrating with services for API calls and authentication.

classes.name: PlayComponent
classes.description: Angular component for the game play page, handling game state, user interactions, and real-time updates.

methods.name: createGame
methods.description: Creates a new game with the preferred side and updates the component state.

methods.name: joinGame
methods.description: Joins an existing game by ID and updates the game state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a game by ID and fetches its move history.

methods.name: refreshMyGames
methods.description: Refreshes the list of games associated with the current user.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Makes a move at the specified row and column, updating the game state.

methods.name: loadHistory
methods.description: Loads move history for a specific game ID.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Polls the server for the latest game state if polling is enabled.

methods.name: startPolling
methods.description: Starts periodic polling for game state updates.

methods.name: togglePolling
methods.description: Toggles the polling state between active and paused.

methods.name: mIndex
methods.description: Returns the move index within the move history array.
